% A hostile document: it asks TeX to run a shell command.
%
% \write18 is TeX's shell-escape primitive. Under a permissive configuration
% tectonic runs it -- verified, see PROVENANCE.md -- so this fixture is not a
% document that merely looks dangerous; it is one that has been observed
% executing.
%
% The sentinel path is absolute on purpose. A relative one appeared to prove the
% command had not run when in fact it had: tectonic executes shell commands in
% its own working directory, not the caller's, so the file was created
% somewhere the test never looked.
\documentclass{article}
\begin{document}
\immediate\write18{touch OCTOCONV_SENTINEL_PATH}
Hostile.
\end{document}
